headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense. Erick Fedde earned the win, while Tyler Schweitzer closed out the game with a save. In other action, the Rangers took down the Guardians 4-2 behind Jacob deGrom's 7.0 innings of work, and the Tigers dominated the Yankees 9-3 with Riley Greene's two-home run performance.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries, with the Royals placing Kris Bubic and Connor Seabold on the injured list due to left elbow soreness and a right lat strain, respectively. The Rangers have also placed Corey Seager on the injured list with lower back inflammation. The Tigers have placed Will Vest on the injured list with right posterior elbow inflammation, and the Red Sox have placed Connelly Early on the injured list with left elbow inflammation.

The Athletics made a trade with the Red Sox, acquiring RHP Ben Hansen in exchange for 3B Brett Harris. The Mariners acquired 1B Buddy Kennedy from the Giants in a cash deal, while the Blue Jays traded RHP Hayden Juenger to the Athletics for C Owen Carapellotti. The Cubs acquired LHP David Peterson from the Mets in exchange for 3B Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Erick Fedde earned the win, while Tyler Schweitzer closed out the game with a save.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Guardians 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob deGrom earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. DeGrom struck out 9 batters and allowed 2 earned runs, while Joc Pederson led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Suffer Shutout Loss to Phillies**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates fell to the Philadelphia Phillies 8-0, marking their latest defeat. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Riley Greene leading the charge at the plate. Greene's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs, while Tarik Skubal dominated on the mound with six shutout innings and nine strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Orioles Cruise Past White Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 6-1 victory. Noah Schultz was a standout on the mound for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Rangers Fall to Guardians in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers in their recent matchup. MacKenzie Gore was among the Guardians' standout performers, while Ezequiel Duran and Elias Díaz led the Rangers' offense.

top_news.title: **Royals Place Kris Bubic on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals left-handed pitcher Kris Bubic has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to left elbow soreness. This move is a result of a status change for the team.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Ben Hansen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics made a move on July 1, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Ben Hansen from the Boston Red Sox in exchange for third baseman Brett Harris.
